Docs.summary: A persisted voice conversation. The Foundry envelope that owns a voice agent's stored transcript, responses, per-turn metrics, and audio. It is the parent, retention, and delete boundary: deleting it cascades to its responses, items, metrics, and audio. When finalization fails, any partial persisted responses, items, and item audio remain readable.
